best_match.fbbt_term: pupal mushroom body anterior paired lateral cell
best_match.fbbt_definition: APL neurons are labelled by GH146-GAL4 and were identified as transcriptional clusters at 24h APF by the expression of markers not expressed by projection neurons (Li et al., 2017; Xie et al., 2021). Mushroom body anterior paired lateral (APL) cell of the pupa, which develops from the larval APL cell and develops into the adult APL cell. There is one of these cells per hemisphere (Xie et al., 2021).

justification: The APL neuron (labelled by GH146; not a projection neuron). Up to the pupal stage the immature or pupal term is used (curator); FBbt #2220, release 2026-11-02. Lineage: the authors' per-cell `lineage` for this type in the main analysis: APL 95, vPN 7, adPN 1.
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00053708 pupal mushroom body anterior paired lateral cell (exact match).
